questions.title: Introduction
questions.text: We are a market research agency conducting a study amongst healthcare professionals to better understand their usage of recent advances in diagnostic and clinical lab testing. The purpose of the study is for market research only and your answers will be held in strict confidence and reported on an anonymous basis.
questions.notes: [All terminates are immediate]

questions.title: S1. Employment affiliation
questions.text: Are you or anyone in your immediate family currently employed by a market research company, a healthcare communication agency, the Food and Drug Administration (FDA), or a medical device, diagnostic, or pharmaceutical company?
questions.notes: All terminates are immediate.

questions.title: S2. Primary care certification or practice type
questions.text: Are you an office-based primary care physician (MD/DO) board-certified as a GP, FP, or IM, or a licensed/board-certified nurse practitioner or physician assistant practicing primary care? [Single Select]
questions.routing: Options 1-5 [Continue]; Other certification or practice type [Terminate]
questions.notes: S2 and S3 are combined for quotas.

questions.title: S3. Practice affiliation and ownership
questions.text: How would you best describe your current practice affiliation and ownership? [Single Select]

options.text: Academic or Teaching Hospital-Owned Health System 2+ affiliated hospitals (AHS)
Community Hospital-Owned Health System, 2+ affiliated hospitals (CHS)
Physician-Owned Group Practice/Network of Practices, 30 or more MD/DOs (POG30+)
Physician-Owned Group Practice/Network of Practices, 5 to 29 MD/DOs (POG5-29)

questions.notes: [combine S2 and S3; Quotas: 40 GP/FP/IM each in AHS, CHS, and POG30+; 30 GP/FP/IM in either POG5-29 or POG1-4); 25 NP and 25 PA]

questions.title: S4. Years in practice
questions.text: How many years have you been in practice?
questions.notes: Years in Practice. Range: 1-40; Terminate if less than 2 yrs or more than 29 yrs.

questions.title: S5. Plans to leave primary care or retire
questions.text: Are you currently planning to leave primary care or retire from practice within the next 2 to 3 years?
questions.notes: All terminates are immediate.

questions.title: S6. Patients seen in an average week
questions.text: How many patients do you see in an average week? [Single Select]
questions.routing: Less than 75 patients per week [Terminate]; all other options [Continue]
questions.notes: All terminates are immediate.

questions.title: S7. Assigned patient panel
questions.text: Do you have an assigned panel of patients you see on a continuing basis?

options.text: Yes, If so, about how many patients are in this panel?

questions.notes: The Yes response includes a numeric follow-up, range 1-5,000.
